review_scope: AI technical review (Claude Opus 5.5); no native-speaker signoff.
note: 2026-10-10: 'Automatic' was a non-word / wrong sense (Automatískt); corrected to the standard term and applied to every caption that quotes the option.

records.key: Automatic: this machine will use the {renderer} renderer.
records.source: Automatic: this machine will use the {renderer} renderer.

records.key: The line weight of the boxes drawn around the wells the detector found in a figure, in image pixels. Automatic picks a width from the figure's size: 2 px, and one more for every 400 px of its longer side. The highlighted well's box is drawn twice as wide. Remembered between sessions.
records.source: The line weight of the boxes drawn around the wells the detector found in a figure, in image pixels. Automatic picks a width from the figure's size: 2 px, and one more for every 400 px of its longer side. The highlighted well's box is drawn twice as wide. Remembered between sessions.
records.translation: Línuþykkt kassanna sem teiknaðir eru utan um brunnana sem skynjarinn fann á mynd, í pixlum myndarinnar. Sjálfvirkt velur breidd út frá stærð myndarinnar: 2 px, og einum meira fyrir hverja 400 px af lengri hlið hennar. Kassi auðkennda brunnsins er teiknaður tvöfalt breiðari. Munað milli lota.

records.key: Where animations are drawn. Off draws on the CPU. Automatic uses the GPU only for dense, high-resolution frames, where it measured faster. On uses the GPU whenever the theme has a GPU renderer. Unsupported graphics or a failed GPU start always fall back to the CPU.

records.translation: Hvar hreyfimyndir eru teiknaðar. Slökkt teiknar á CPU. Sjálfvirkt notar GPU aðeins fyrir þétta ramma í hárri upplausn, þar sem hann mældist hraðari. Kveikt notar GPU hvenær sem þemað hefur GPU-teiknara. Óstudd grafík eða misheppnuð ræsing GPU fellur alltaf aftur á CPU.
